parse.text:
Unobtainable Unit
This unit is currently unobtainable since Update 17 - Fate Update - 30 September 2023

Overview

Smoka is a MythicalMythical Limited unit. He is only obtainable once you get to rank 25 in Key Hunt and buying Premium Pass for his shiny version.

Evolving

Smoka can evolve into Smoka (Hunter) with the following materials:

Why do I have different stats?
Units in this game use a randomized system, where stats like damage are randomly rolled with about a 10% variance (like Dungeon Quest items). When you evolve a unit they also reroll their stats, but it will always be strictly better than the pre-evolved version.
